reader.notes: Re-read after kb/Work PB2328 moved LogicalLineBuilder out of ReferenceFormatProcessor into its own file (LogicalLineBuilder.cs); Add, ContinueFixed and Join are unchanged but for indentation and two comment citations (diff -w against the merge base). Continuation is resolved in the reference-format logical-line builder before COPY and REPLACE see the text, so a continued character-string of pseudo-text is the ordinary fixed-form ContinueFixed join: a word or numeric literal from the first nonblank character of area B, a nonnumeric literal from after the continuation line's quotation mark, the continued line kept to margin R. ContinueFloating is the 2002+ floating-indicator path, not taken at 85.

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85 on this branch's build. f2.cob: REPLACE ==PUT-IT== BY ==MOVE "ABC with its closing quotation mark at margin R (column 72), continued by -"DEF" TO WS- / -TH / (a slant comment line) / -ING==: exit 0, [ABC + 52 spaces + "DEF ]: the quotation mark at column 72 closed the literal and the continuation's quotation mark is its successor, one doubled quotation mark (f2.g.cs stores ABC, 52 spaces, a quotation mark and DEF), and WS-THING was formed over three lines. f3.cob, no over-reject: REPLACE ==SHOW / IT== with IT in area A on a line with NO hyphen is accepted and SHOW IT. displays 4 (§1985:IV.7.2.5: "The text words and the separator space comprising pseudo-text may start in either area A or area B"). At --std 2023 f2 is refused COBOL0902. ContinueFixed serves COPY and REPLACE alike (f1 of 1985-SR-XII.2.3-5). cite.py: OK §1985:XII.3.3 SR5; OK §1985:IV.7.2.2; OK §1985:IV.7.2.5.
